PLAN "Bodyweight + Bar Strength: 12-Week Beginner Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "build full-body strength with bodyweight and pull-up bar"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull Intro":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower/Core Intro":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Focus + Antagonists":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 5x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 5x2..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull Progress":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower/Core Progress":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x25..35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Emphasis Progress":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 5x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 5x3..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x25..35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Volume Build":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 4x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Volume Build":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 4x30..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Strength Build":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 6x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 6x2..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          push_up 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x25..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Deload Technique":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Deload Technique":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          reverse_lunge 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x20..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Deload Technique":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 4x10..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 4x2..4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 2x20..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
  PHASE "Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Push/Pull Strength":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 6x1..4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Strength + Balance":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Strength + Midback":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 6x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 6x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          inverted_row 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x30..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Density":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 6x10..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          pull_up 7x1..4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank_up 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Density":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x12..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 4x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Density":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 6x15..25 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 7x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          inverted_row 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Strength Emphasis":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 6x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 8x2..4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 4x40..50 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Strength Emphasis":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x15..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 4x35..50 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Strength Peak":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 6x20..25 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 8x4..5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          inverted_row 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 5x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x35..50 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Deload":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          pull_up 4x2..3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30..40 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Deload":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x25..35 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Deload":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 4x12..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 4x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x25..35 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
  PHASE "Consolidation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Strength + Volume":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 6x12..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 8x3..5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 5x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank_up 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Strength + Volume":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x15..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 4x40..55 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pull Strength Consolidation":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 6x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 8x4..6 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          inverted_row 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 5x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x40..55 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Mixed Rep Targets":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 6x4..6 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 4x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Mixed Rep Targets":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 4x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pull Peak Reps":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 6x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 8x5..7 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          inverted_row 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 5x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Strength Test Prep":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x15..25 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 6x4..7 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank_up 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Capacity Peak":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 4x50..65 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pull Strength Test Prep":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 6x25..35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 8x6..8 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          inverted_row 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 5x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x50..65 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Deload/Test":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x12..20 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          pull_up 5x3..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Deload/Test":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..14 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x40..60 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Deload/Test":
        warmup:
          walking 5m

          hangboard 4x20..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 6x4..7 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          inverted_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x40..60 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
